messages:
Priya (Finance): FYI invoice from CloudLine is on hold by AP bot — rate in the invoice doesn't match our signed SOW and there's no PO reference. Can someone take a look? :eyes:

Ben (AP): Thanks — can you paste the invoice number and a screenshot or the attachment? AP bot flagged 'PO not found'.

Priya (Finance): Attached snippet from the vendor email below. Invoice number 2026-CL-489. No PO on the PDF.

```
Invoice: 2026-CL-489
Vendor: CloudLine Networks
Line items:
  GPU-hours: 10,000 @ $0.09 = $900.00
  Early-pay discount (2%): -$18.00
Total due: $882.00
PO: <blank>
```

Ben (AP): We have PO 3489 for CloudLine but that was for the Sept spot purchase at $0.07/hr and was closed. The invoice rate is $0.09 — need either a PO that matches this line or a signed amendment. AP bot: approval hold reason = "PO mismatch / missing attachments".

Lauren (Vendor Liaison): Pinged CloudLine just now. They say they moved to a new pricing tier (v2) in Feb and claim it's retroactive. I don't see a signed amendment in our shared drive. @Ben do we accept vendor-initiated rate changes without a signed change order?

Ben (AP): No, we need a signed amendment or a PO that explicitly references the new rate. Otherwise AP can't process. If vendor can provide a signed amendment we can route for approval.

cloudline-billing-bot: Invoice 2026-CL-489 uploaded to AP queue by Lauren and flagged: missing PO.

Alex (SRE): Just flagging impact: if we block this invoice AP might trigger late fees on their side — but we should not pay the higher rate without contract.

Priya (Finance): Agreed. Two options: 1) Ask vendor to reissue under PO 3489 (if they agree to previous rate) OR 2) provide signed amendment plus new PO number so AP can match and route.

Lauren (Vendor Liaison): I'll ask CloudLine to either reissue or send the signed amendment by EOD. If they want to bill retroactively we should get a signed doc. I'll CC legal if needed. :email:

Ben (AP): If vendor sends amendment, please include an explicit statement like: "This amendment supersedes previous SOW and sets GPU rate to $0.09/hr effective 2026-02-01" and reference their invoice number. That will let us create/update a PO and route for approvals.

Priya (Finance): Also, hold for discounts — AP bot calculated early-pay discount but we won't apply until PO/amendment validated.

Lauren (Vendor Liaison): Understood. Messaging vendor now. Will post reply here when I have doc or reissued invoice.

Ben (AP): Thanks. If no doc by EOD, I'll escalate to VP Finance for a decision on accepting the amendment retroactively.

Priya (Finance): Thanks all. @Lauren please tag me on vendor response. I'll update the AP ticket once we get the attachment. :white_check_mark:
